tools.name: grocery_price_history
tools.description: Monthly BLS average prices of one item between two months (most items go back to 1980): every month, the first and last price and the change, the high and low with their months, and yearly averages. Default the last 24 published months.

tools.name: grocery_prices_compare
tools.description: Several items side by side from BLS average price data: the latest monthly price and unit, the change from last month and from a year ago, the biggest 12-month increases and decreases, and any item at a record high.
